WE Are here to help
The Mission of the Butler County Mental Health and Addiction Recovery Services Board is to faithfully secure, administer and monitor the public funds provided by the Federal, State and County governments and grants. Additionally, the Board through partnerships, collaboration and the convening of stakeholders will use this funding to support its county providers. These designated programs and services will address prevention, treatment and recovery of Mental and Addiction Health for individuals, families and communities in need of such local services.

We are here for you, to answer your questions or provide information. You can reach us at 513-860-9240.
YEAR END DEADLINE
In order to comply with the County Auditor's 2025 calendar year deadline, all invoices and\or claims must be submitted to the Board no later than December 3, 2025. Click here for more information.
Provider Quarterly Meeting
The next quarterly provider meeting will be held on 1/8/2026 at 11:00 a.m. Please see the calendar page for WebEx information!
Text the Crisis Hotline
The Crisis Hotline can now be accessed via the telephone or text messages! Please call or text, 1-844-427-4747 .
If you experience technical difficulties reaching the above crisis hotline, please call the National Crisis Hotline at 988.
